analysis: Documentation-only PR. docs/reference/README.md (head line 10) adds a link to nemotron-super-image-formats.md, whose content is not in the supplied evidence. docs/reference/configuration.md (head lines 320-323) documents four new environment variables for the unpublished Nemotron Super local owner. They are DARKBLOOM_NEMOTRON_SUPER_MTP, _MTP_DEPTH, _MTP_VERIFICATION and _MAX_CONCURRENT. They are opt-in, read at process start, and not forwarded to LaunchAgents. Because they are not forwarded, a background daemon cannot be given them; they apply to foreground and local processes. The docs claim invalid values fail the load rather than falling back, and that the speculating owner refuses media. DARKBLOOM_CBV2_MTP is said to remain a kill switch. MAX_CONCURRENT is documented as bounded 1..64 and requiring the KV grant to hold every request's fixed bytes. Batched decode with more than one concurrent request touches TB-007 and T-028 (residual KV data) and T-041 (prefix cache). No source code was supplied, so I could not verify these claims. They create no cache sharing or scope change in the docs. I found no change to attestation, authorization, encryption, TTL or the cache gate, so T-041 is unaffected on the documentation evidence. Next-pass check: if Swift sources (NemotronSuperLocalMTP.swift, NemotronSuperLocalAdmission.swift) appear in another batch, confirm that batched or MTP rows keep per-request cacheSalt and KV isolation and do not cross-contaminate rows. Also confirm that the fail-closed parsing matches the docs and that the media refusal is enforced.
